transcript: It. It's been amazing. Just coming out here and sharing it with you all has been such an incredible gift. And it's a very different experience than. Than doing a play anywhere else. Like, I've done plays all across this country, and doing a play for a New York audience that comes to the theater ready to have a good time and ready to participate is just like such a gift, and it's like an actual dream come true. So thank you so much.
